newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom dividend over 1 bln FFR - FT.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom dividend over 1 bln FFR - FT.

text.p: France Telecom could pay out more than one billion francs in dividend in 1997, its first year of bourse listing, the London Financial Times said on Tuesday.
It said France Telecom chairman Michel Bon had said the company would pay out 45 percent of its net profits in dividend, the same as the annual payments to the state at the moment.
For this amount, France Telecom would need to make a 1997 profit of 11 billion francs, against 9.2 billion in 1995.
Bon was quoted as saying the group would take between 15 and 30 billion in provisions in 1996, taking total provisions to 100 billion.
From 1997, debt should fall by between 10 and 15 billion a year.
France Telecom was not immediately avaialble for comment.
The government is expected to sell a first tranche of some 20 percent in France Telecom in April.
